sections.question: Using the same method Chevron applies to its full-year return on capital employed, what was Chevron's ROCE for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026? Give the percentage to one decimal place.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Doc 10: Chevron's full-year ROCE divides ROCE earnings (reported earnings plus noncontrolling interest plus after-tax interest expense) by average capital employed; for 2025 the table shows ROCE earnings of 13,581, average capital employed of 205,316 and ROCE of 6.6%. Its footnote defines capital employed as stockholders' equity plus total debt plus noncontrolling interest and says average capital employed "is computed by averaging the sum of capital employed at the beginning and the end of the period".

Step 2. Doc 10 and Doc 12: ROCE earnings for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026 = 13,581 (Doc 10, full-year 2025) - 6,469 (Doc 12, six months ended June 30, 2025) + 15,135 (Doc 12, six months ended June 30, 2026) = 22,247 ($ millions).

Step 3. Doc 8: capital employed at June 30, 2025 = 146,417 (stockholders' equity) + 29,467 (total debt) + 841 (noncontrolling interests) = 176,725.

Step 4. Doc 12: capital employed at June 30, 2026 = 189,883 (stockholders' equity) + 37,075 (total debt) + 5,675 (noncontrolling interests) = 232,633.

Step 5. Doc 8 and Doc 12: average capital employed = (146,417 + 29,467 + 841 + 189,883 + 37,075 + 5,675) / 2 = 204,679.

Step 6. Doc 8, Doc 10 and Doc 12: ROCE = (13,581 - 6,469 + 15,135) / ((146,417 + 29,467 + 841 + 189,883 + 37,075 + 5,675) / 2) = 10.9% (to one decimal place).

Decoy check. Doc 12 prints ROCE of 21.4% for the second quarter of 2026 and 13.0% for the first half of 2026, and Doc 10 prints 6.6% for 2025; none covers the twelve months ended June 30, 2026.

Decoy check. Doc 10 and Doc 12: dividing by Doc 12's printed six-month average capital employed instead gives (13,581 - 6,469 + 15,135) / 232,784 = 9.6%.

Decoy check. Doc 8, Doc 10 and Doc 12: leaving out noncontrolling interest (the "Total debt plus total stockholders' equity" lines) gives (13,581 - 6,469 + 15,135) / ((175,884 + 226,958) / 2) = 11.0%.
